Inglenook Day colors for the Mod Organizer 2 mod list and plugin list.

Open Settings, then the Theme tab. Under Colors, double-click a row, type its
value into the HTML box, set Alpha channel to 255, and click OK.

Is overwritten (loose files)            #d5ded0
Is overwriting (loose files)            #e4d6d1
Is overwritten (archives)               #cddbd2
Is overwriting (archives)               #dfd3d1
Mod contains selected file              #d2dddf
Plugin is contained in selected mod     #d2dddf
Plugin is master of selected plugin     #cbdeda
